profile.headline: Senior Graphics Software Engineer at Center for Computation and Visualization at Brown University
profile.summary:
Master in Computer Science from Digipen Institute of technology in Redmond, WA. I'm passionate about software engineering, computer graphics and of course games development.
I am a software developer with 4 years of work experience in the industry developing Java enterprise applications and managing data bases Oracle. 
In the last two years I have had  the change to learn and implement game engines in C++, advanced concepts in computer graphics and networking for Video Games

positions.title: Senior Research Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designing and implementing visual OpenGL 3D applications to display scientific data used by the University’s researchers
● Maintaining existing C++/OpenGL 3D graphics applications to visualize data on virtual reality and multi-display systems
● Researching rendering techniques to visualize scientific data in using distributable hyper computing (HPC)
● Collaborating with researches on best practices and rendering techniques to visualize large amount of data in real time
● Maintaining the University’s 3D virtual reality theater YURT

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Debugged, maintained and built features on a custom rendering engine for open terrains and distributed military simulations
•	Improved application functionalities to decrease calls to hard disk and simulation load time.
•	Helped extending the engine API  to facilitate their use maintainability to adjust the engine for customer requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During six months I was in charge of implementing the front and back end of a Java EE application using Jsf, EJB in a Glassfish Server and Oracle as the database manager.
I Used JasperReports to generate pdf reports on the national education test for senior students
The software was used by the national department of education of Colombia to measure the quality of high schools nationwide

positions.title: Technical Consultant Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for support enterprise end user systems, to include network and server technical troubleshooting.
Supporting both Web and In-house application and various ancillary applications
Worked with SLA to prioritize tasks

positions.title: Technical Consultant Engineer
positions.description: I was in charge of supporting and adding new functionalities to an in-house Java EE application used for local and international monetary transactions. This software was customized according to the client's requirements in order to be used in different countries such as Colombia, Mexico, The Caribean and Venezuela.
